text: #729, built by hand to save Codex credits. Refines D-0173 and keeps D-0286 and D-0390. CI's invariant/integration shards run every integration-tagged test in internal/verify, internal/synth, internal/formalize, internal/conformance and internal/plumbing on hand pull requests and the factory's plumbing pull requests, and invariant/gate needs that job. So those tests, the gate against the real verifiers and the pinned-TLC checks among them, aren't merger work. The built-in plan prompt says so, so a plan doesn't leave them to the merger, and the built-in review prompt no longer lists them under Merger work. SPEC, docs/factory.md, docs/statecharts.md and docs/dashboard.md say the same. Checks CI can't run stay merger work, such as the plumbing sandbox's real-image budget check when D-0390 applies. Before, #720's and #728's reviews listed the pinned-TLC checks, which CI's integration shards had already run and passed.
